summary: One question, one answer: is this safe to launch?
signature: 4 scanners, 1 verdict, coverage stated every time
highlights: Runs access control, secrets, payments and deploy readiness, then grades the result
A scanner that is not installed did not pass - it did not run, and a partial run is never graded clear
Only proven findings can block. Pattern matches raise the verdict and say so, because being loudly wrong gets a tool switched off
One finding per place, not one per tool that noticed it - two scanners agreeing is not two problems
requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux), plus whichever Ship-Safe scanners you have installed. No network.
notes: A CLEAR verdict does not mean safe - it means four scanners found nothing proven. It cannot see your hosting dashboard, it cannot tell you whether your database has a backup, and it stops being true at your next deploy.
